text_block_list.text:
With January drawing to a close,
the New Year's hustle and bustle has finally started to settle down.
To discuss training policy, I went to pick up Symboli Rudolf at the student dorm as requested, when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so sorry.
Going out of your way to even arrange a car to my family's home...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. The fact that you returned safely
is reason enough to celebrate."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The student council will support you even more
this year leading up to your debut.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Don't hesitate to rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
P-President...
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Now then, was that girl the last one?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun.
You're already here, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm here to welcome you back.
Now everyone has returned safely to the Academy.

"Still, it's already the end of January—hard to believe someone hasn't returned from visiting home yet.
As I tilt my head in thought—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Every year, there are a few girls who go home
to their families and never end up coming back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Crushed by the sheer cruelty and intensity of the race,
and disappointed in yourself, only to feel the warmth of family.
...It's no wonder one would want to give up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If that is truly for her own sake,
then I, too, shall bestow my blessings upon her new beginning."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... if even a fragment of that girl's
spirit still remains on the turf...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes people need a little push
to try challenging themselves again, don't they?

"Come to think of it, for a while after the New Year's shrine visit,
there were frequent periods when Symboli Rudolf couldn't be reached..."
choice_data_list: Did you go around calling out to people yourself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Ordinarily, I should probably leave this to Air Groove
and the others, though."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I tend to come across as intimidating.
I judged that the others would be better suited for this, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing how busy Air Groove is at the end of the year,
I cannot burden her with my selfishness."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In truth, it is likely selfish. With so many students, seeking to guide them all borders on sheer arrogance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Coming out to welcome them today is also
a departure from regular Student Council duties."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I can't very well ask you to join me.
...Not even you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Alright! We were meeting to discuss our training policy, right? Without further ado—
(Snort!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, I have an incoming call.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It might be urgent business.
Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hello, this is Symboli Rudolf.
What is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—What!?
Air Groove did... !?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President...? 
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! I heard you collapsed...!
Are you all right?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... not a problem.
Arrangements have already been made so that business operations are unaffected.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Brian will give instructions regarding the handover—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Am I mistaken? I was asking whether you were alright
regarding your own physical condition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Never mind the paperwork.
I can take care of it all later.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If a handover is necessary,
the doctor must have ordered complete rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What was the diagnosis?
Tell me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It is merely simple exhaustion.
My sincere apologies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Say, Air Groove.
Why are you apologizing to me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "If anything, it is I who should be apologizing to you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Overworking is unmistakably the President's responsibility.
It is due to my poor personnel management... I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because of my shortcomings as President,
I have caused trouble for you... and everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I... I find my immature self infuriating,
pathetic, and utterly unforgivable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And now, I have made my resolve. This year, I will pour my heart and soul into the Student Council even more than the last.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I will take on a few of the tasks you currently hold."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No,
that would interfere with the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've always balanced both up until now.
A little extra on my plate won't be a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, placing any more burden on the President
as she walks the path of "Emperor"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —If I cannot protect everyone, what kind of 'Emperor' am I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, you have a dream too, don't you?
A dream to achieve glory as an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And yet, collapsing halfway won't do you any good.
Student council duties do not take precedence over your dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"So leave everything else to me
and get some well-deserved rest."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …………――Do not underestimate me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are we merely dreams you are meant to protect...
and nothing more?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You told me not to apologize,
saying it was entirely your own responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If we do that, though... then we're no better than little children...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, President.
You are mistaken...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I... we are...――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove?
Are you alright!?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you two doing?!
Air Groove-san, you're supposed to be resting in bed!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for bothering you, Air Groove.
I'll come visit you again.

Thanks to taking some rest,
Air Groove thankfully recovered quickly.
After apologizing for her discourtesy—

Symboli Rudolf offered an apology as well.
On the surface, things seemed resolved, but—
This matter seemed to cast a dark shadow over Symboli Rudolf's heart...
